In detail

A large riverside district split between the more upscale Újlipótváros (bordering District V) and the more industrial Angyalföld. A March 2023 police residential-burglary map named District XIII as a specific hotspot, with eight burglaries recorded in a single corridor between Béke utca and Reitter Ferenc utca since the previous August alone. Not named among the nightlife or violent-crime hotspots. Sources checked: Infostart.hu, 21 Mar 2023 (police burglary-hotspot map).
